import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { mockBlogPosts } from "../mockBlogPosts";

import Link from "next/link";

import postdata from "../../../../../public/postsdata.json";
import { BlogPost } from "@/services/model";

// export const instant = false;

// Generate on BUILD:
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  // TODO: select posts from database:
  const items = mockBlogPosts.slice(0, 4);

  return items.map((item) => ({ postId: String(item.id) }));

/**
 * Strona Posta
 */
export default async function PostPage(props: PageProps<"/blog/[postId]">) {
  const { postId } = await props.params;

  await delay(1_000, 1_000);

  const post: BlogPost | undefined = postdata.find(
    (p) => p.id == Number(postId),
  );

  if (!post) {
    notFound(); // never!
  }

  if (postId == "500") throw new Error("Server Error");
  if (postId == "404") notFound();
  if (postId == "301") redirect("products", "replace");
  // if (postId == "429" && Math.random() > 0.1)
  //   throw new Error("Too many requests" + Math.random());

  return (
    <div>
      <h3 className="text-2xl">Post {postId}</h3>

      <div className="grid gap-2" key={post.id}>
        <h3 className="text-xl">
          <Link href={`/blog/${post.id}/`}>{post.title}</Link>
        </h3>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Next.js components, layouts and pages

## Rules

- Prefer Server Components. Add `"use client"` only for state, effects, event handlers, or browser-only hooks (e.g. `usePathname`). Keep client parts small and at the leaves.
- Reuse components from `src/components/ui/` for repeatable layout and interactive elements before writing new markup.
- Missing component: search with `mcp_shadcn_get_add_command_for_items` or the shadcn registry tools, then ask the user whether to install it or create it manually. Do not install or create it without confirmation.
- Use semantic Tailwind tokens from `src/app/globals.css` (e.g. `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`). Do not hardcode colors (`bg-gray-100`, `text-blue-500`, `#fff`).
- For complex layouts, compose compound components (`Card` + `CardHeader` + `CardContent`) instead of adding configuration props.
- Class names: `import { cn } from "cn"` (as in `src/components/ui/*.tsx`; `src/lib/utils.ts` re-exports it). Merge user classes last: `cn("base-classes", className)`.
- Every component accepts `className` and spreads remaining props.
- Button is built on Base UI: there is no `asChild`. Use `render`: `<Button render={<Link href="/cart" />} nativeButton={false}>Cart</Button>`.
- Never nest a `Button` inside a Trigger. Use `<DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button />}>`.
- `DropdownMenuLabel` must sit inside `DropdownMenuGroup`.

/**
 * Lista postów na blogu
 * http://localhost:3000/blog/
 */
export default async function BlogPostListPage(props: PageProps<"/blog">) {
  const { query = "" } = await props.searchParams;

  // let filtered = query as string

  // let filtered = String(query ?? '')
  if (typeof query !== "string") {
    throw new Error("Invalid query");
  }

  await delay(500, 1_000);

  const filteredPosts = mockBlogPosts.filter((p) =>
    p.title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query.toLocaleLowerCase()),
  );

  return (
    <>
      {/* .grid.grid-cols-2.gap-5>.grid.gap-2*2>h3.text-xl{Title $$} */}
      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        {filteredPosts.map((p) => (
          <div className="grid gap-2" key={p.id}>
            <h3 className="text-xl">
              <Link href={`/blog/${p.id}/`}>{p.title}</Link>
            </h3>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

In [page.tsx](<C:/Projects/sages-nextjs-open-1126/src/app/(marketing)/blog/[postId]/page.tsx>) I added:

```tsx
sizes="(min-width: 768px) 376px, (min-width: 640px) 50vw, 100vw"
```

- **Below 640px:** one column, so the image is full width (`100vw`).
- **640–767px:** two columns, so each is half the viewport (`50vw`).
- **768px and up:** the post is capped at `max-w-3xl` (768px). Each column is (768 − 16px gap) / 2 = 376px, so the browser can download a 376px-wide image instead of a full-viewport one.

The `Math.random()` prerender errors in the console are from before this change.
